notes.title: [Version update] Optimize the loading speed of model and dance list UI
notes.content:
When there are too many models or dances in the Installed list, in the previous version, the speed of switching models or dancing UI was too slow or even stuck for about few seconds. 
After the deep optimization of this version, no matter how many models dance in the Installed list, it can be very smooth and instantly open in seconds. No more stuttering issues.

notes.title: [Version Update] Add Global Hotkey Options; Add "Boss Coming" Hotkey
notes.content:
1. Added "Settings > Global Hotkey" option page, you can set global hotkeys to quickly operations such as play/pause, next track, previous track, adjust volume, display/hide the main window, Hide All, and bring the model to the top.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35146874/f5f70d4573c837e5a2e4040fdb9a91a398095f82.png[/img]


2. Add the  "Boss Coming"  Hotkey : One-key to pause the song and hide all models, press it again to restore the display and then play music and dance, the default hotkey is Shift+Alt+S . And the software will automatically release all CPU and GPU usage when paused, so you can play the game without worrying about dropped frames. This  function can also be directly clicked on the tray right-click popup menu item "Hide All" to enable.



3. Buy “DesktopMagicEngine” will Get "DesktopMMD4: Born to Dance" for Free.  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1968650/MMD4/

notes.title: [FREE UPATE] DesktopMMD4: Born to Dance Released! It's time for dance again now!
notes.content:
[b]If you have purchased DesktopMagicEngine or DesktopMMD3 then it will be given to your library for free.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35146874/6186abe9122310750ae3d5607bc3bd27f408fac8.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1968650/



[h2]IT'S TIME FOR DANCE AGAIN NOW![/h2]
DesktopMMD4 is mainly born to solve the clip through problem of the previous version of the model and the inability to directly import VMD dance files. After more than a year of exploration, I finally found a new way and fully switched to the original MMD technology framework, which not only realized the ability to directly support the import MMD's VMD dance action files, and directly use the original MMD physics engine to dance without the problem of clip through the model, and even directly support the lip-sync and facial with the VMD dance, making it easier for the model to dance on the desktop with richer details.



[h2]WHAT'S NEW[/h2]
(1) Support Directly import the VMD dance motion files of MMD without conversion, and supports the lip-sync and facial expressions .
(2) Support directly import the PMX/PMD model file of MMD without conversion and better compatibility .
(3) Support the physical effects of MMD, and no longer clip through model when dancing.
(4) Support switch two rendering styles of model with one click: 2D Anime rendering style and 3D realistic rendering style.
(5) Support directly import the VPD action file of MMD without conversion.
(6) Support multiplayer motions in a dance, allowing multiple models to load different VMDs to dance different motions.
(7) Brand-New lightweight rendering engine, which uses less system resources and reduces the GPU usage by as much as 60% compared with the previous generation.


[h2]MORE VIDEO PREVIEW[/h2]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1968650/videos/?p=1&browsefilter=mostrecent
